items: P2.3 (fourth retained unit: low-VGPR 16-column Q4T16 owners)
title: Low-VGPR 16-column Q4T16 prefill owners retained (rows 17-48)

host.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

change.summary: OUT_TILES_PER_BLOCK template parameter (default 3 = byte-identical existing instantiations) plus <false,2,1> and <false,3,1> low-VGPR owners: one 16-column out tile per 32-thread block with 16/24-float accumulators. gfx1151 bands: rows 17-32 lowvgpr on all six shapes; rows 33-48 lowvgpr48 on {(5120,17408),(5120,10240),(5120,12288)} and lowvgpr on the other three; rows 49-64 single-wave 48-col; >=65 and unadmitted shapes retain shared-B fail-closed.
change.basis: Iteration-8 counter attribution: the 248-VGPR owners are latency-bound at ~2 waves/SIMD; the smaller accumulator footprint restores residency.

selection_evidence.harness: scripts/gguf_q4_t16_dense_prefill_owner_microbench.py (synthetic Q4T16, bit-exact cross-validation max_abs 0.0 on all shapes/rows)
selection_evidence.rows_49_64: 48-column single-wave owner retains the band; crossovers measured at rows 56/64

server_prefill_frozen_protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 .venv/bin/python3 scripts/gguf_mtp_c1c8_server_bench.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1151 --quant Q4_K_M --execution-profile production --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --widths 1,2 --max-tokens 1 --candidate-budget 3 --batch-window-ms 50 --max-sequence-length 1024 --expected-mtp-widths '' --correctness-contract ar_exact
server_prefill_frozen_protocol.correctness: every cell ar_self_exact / mtp_self_exact / ar_mtp_equal passed

kernel_trace_evidence.command: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace on the isolated 45-token forced-bulk bench

measured_pass.note: Q4 dense VGPR fell 248 -> 96/80 (4-6 waves/SIMD residency). Next families with the same pattern: q6_k_t16_qmicro_planar (184 VGPR, 103.1 ms), gguf_q5_t16_dense (200 VGPR, 35.9 ms).

gates.red: routing test extended RED-first; it also caught a 33-48 fall-through bug before commit
gates.full_suite: only the 3 pre-existing test_specdec2_perf_bridge ordering flakes; compileall, check_fixtures, smoke registry, smoke cpu-fixtures OK
gates.exactness: bit-exact vs shared-B on all six shapes and rows 17-64 sampled (max_abs 0.0); real-model ar_exact contracts passed

remaining_walls: Q6 qmicro-planar + Q5 T16 prefill families (~139 ms/pass at 184/200 VGPR - same latency-bound pattern)
